news.title: Plug Power Completes Front-End Engineering for Arcadia's 280 MW Texas Project as California Plant En
Yari Resources (ASX:YAR): Arcadia Acquisition and Coal Resource Review

bullets: Own product strategy and roadmap for a defined portfolio within Arcadia's platform, partnering day-to-day with an embedded engineering teams through the full SDLC.
Translate business goals, customer needs, and technical realities into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and well-scoped increments engineering can execute against.
Engage deeply with engineering on data pipeline, data models, and enrichment asking the right technical questions and making informed calls when priorities conflict.
Run and participate in agile ceremonies: backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and incident/RCA reviews, ensuring engineering has what it needs to move fast without…
Deconstruct ambiguous or large-scale goals into MVPs and iterative delivery plans, adjusting scope based on technical constraints and customer feedback.
